query: I want to automate this whole workflow. Set up hooks and CI so that every gate is checked automatically — if the pipeline is green, the change is approved and we merge. Which gates can you wire up?
expected_behavior: Separates the rules that are objectively decidable from the ones that require judgment, rather than attempting to automate all of them
Names specific gate checks that cannot be mechanized — spec testability, design soundness, whether research findings are true, comprehension — and explains why
Pushes back on 'green pipeline means approved', stating that mechanical checks verify rules were followed, not that the rules were right
Proposes the contract-freeze lock as a pre-write hook, since it is objectively decidable and currently enforced only by convention
Warns against hooks that warn but never block, and against giving a CI job the name of a gate
Does not refuse the automation request — it delivers the automatable portion and is explicit about what remains human
